tmp_path = WindowsPath('{lane-out}/tmp/pytest-of-{user}/pytest-11/test_qc_tm_10b_1_a2l_refresh_c0')
@pytest.mark.serial_timing def test_qc_tm_10b_1_a2l_refresh_cost_on_the_largest_a2l(tmp_path: Path) -> None: """QC-TM-10b-1: the UI-thread time of one in-place write's A2L refresh (``_refresh_a2l_values_after_write``) on the largest A2L the repo ships (case_06, re-pointed at E5 R-1) stays under ``timing_bound(1.0)``; the tag count is in the QC-TM label.
The refresh is timed where the write notice calls it (the method wrapped on the app instance, one real apply of the complement of the byte at ``0x80100005`` through the Patch Editor). After the bound, the enriched tags must equal a full recompute over the written image (the partial recompute of R-1 must describe the same bytes). Negative controls: the full refresh at every write -> above the bound -> RED; a changed-byte test that reads only a tag's first byte -> the tags covering ``0x80100005`` keep their old values -> RED.""" from s19_app.tui.services.a2l_service import enrich_tags_and_render
async def scenario(app, pilot, log): await load_image(pilot, app, CASE06 / "firmware.s19", timeout=240.0) await load_a2l(pilot, app, CASE06 / "firmware.a2l", timeout=240.0) await wait_until( pilot, lambda: app._a2l_enriched_key is not None and len(app._a2l_enriched_tags) > 0, "the case_06 tags were never enriched", timeout=240.0, ) assert hasattr(app, "_refresh_a2l_values_after_write"), ( "the write notice has no A2L refresh to time" ) real = app._refresh_a2l_values_after_write spans: list = []
def timed(*args, **kwargs): start = time.perf_counter() try: return real(*args, **kwargs) finally: spans.append(time.perf_counter() - start)
app._refresh_a2l_values_after_write = timed tags = len(app._a2l_enriched_tags) old = mem_at(app, CASE06_WRITE) assert old is not None, "0x80100005 is not in the case_06 image" await patch_apply( pilot, app, log, tmp_path / "docs", "d.json", [(CASE06_WRITE, bytes([old ^ 0xFF]))] ) assert mem_at(app, CASE06_WRITE) == old ^ 0xFF, "the apply did not write" await wait_until( pilot, lambda: bool(spans), "the write notice never ran the A2L refresh", timeout=240.0, ) elapsed = spans[0] print(f"QC-TM-10b-1 case_06: {tags} tags, {elapsed:.3f} s") assert elapsed < report_margin( f"QC-TM-10b-1 A2L refresh {tags} tags", elapsed, timing_bound(1.0) ), f"{tags} tags: {elapsed:.3f} s" full, _lines = enrich_tags_and_render( app.current_a2l_data, app.current_file.mem_map, max_tag_lines=500 ) differ = [ i for i, (got, want) in enumerate(zip(app._a2l_enriched_tags, full)) if got != want ] assert len(app._a2l_enriched_tags) == len(full) and not differ, ( f"{len(differ)} enriched tags differ from a full recompute " f"(first {differ[:3]}; {len(app._a2l_enriched_tags)} vs {len(full)} tags)" )
